name: Instatus
summary: Instatus offers a free Starter plan with 200 subscribers, 15 monitors and 5 team members. Pro starts at $20 a month with 5,000 subscribers and SMS alerts. Subscribers can follow by email, SMS, webhook, chat tools and feeds.

facts.text: Public pages are open to anyone with the link, without a login, and visitors can subscribe through any channel the owner enables.
Subscriber channels are email, SMS through a connected provider, signed webhooks, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Google Chat, X, RSS and Atom feeds, and a public API.
Adding an incident update lets the author choose whether to notify subscribers.
Enterprise adds a 99.99% uptime SLA, SCIM directory sync and multiple SSO connections.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 15 monitors at 2-minute checks, email alerts only, 5 team members, 200 subscribers, no custom domain

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Listed as from $20 a month in the page title; the plan card shows only the unit. 50 monitors at 30-second checks, email and SMS alerts, 5,000 subscribers, one or more custom domains. Yearly billing shows 25% off.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Shown with monthly billing, but no price appeared on the page we read. 1,000 monitors, 25,000 subscribers, SAML SSO.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: No price shown on the page we read. Adds a 99.99% uptime SLA, SCIM directory sync and multiple SSO connections.

hiddenCosts: The Pro price is shown as a starting figure, and the pricing table itself did not repeat the amount.
The page uses a dollar sign without naming the currency.
SMS delivery on status page subscriptions needs a connected SMS provider.
